writes.detail: If the actor is not in the current room, _pos is set to the snapped point at once and _facing to the object's direction, without walking. The _ignoreTurns guard on the facing is always false in v5, because only v6/v8 actorOps set it.
_moving = (_moving & MF_IN_LEG) | MF_NEW_LEG. It is cleared after arrival and after the final turn.

Facing follows the walking direction. On arrival the actor turns to the object's direction, oldDirToNewDir(actordir & 3), through MF_TURN. If the actor is already at the destination, only that turn happens. remapDirection can override or flip the final facing, so it need not equal the object's direction. It does so when the destination box has direction flags (getBoxFlags & 7) or _extraBoxFlags, or when the actor has class XFlip/YFlip.

Walking stops and _moving ends at 0. MF_TURN can follow only for an actor that was already visible in the current room. For that actor, the stand animation plays if it was moving, and if the new box has direction flags (flags & 7), turnToDirection(_facing) sets _moving = MF_TURN. That runs once per frame after scripts (object.cpp:1165-1176; scumm.cpp:3286), so a setState earlier in the same frame is not seen until the next frame. The class check reads _classData live. The owner table is not checked. A picked-up object that is still in the local table is skipped only because o5_pickupObject sets class 32 (script_v5.cpp:2027-2030). Overlaps are resolved by local-table order. Direct coordinates are bytes (getVarOrDirectByte), so constants above 255 need a variable. Only the handler's own writes are observable. An object owned by an actor but not in _inventory is WIO_NOT_FOUND and logs a warning (object.cpp:361-368; script.cpp:122-125). Nesting deeper than kMaxScriptNesting (15) is a hard error (script.h:116; script.cpp:351-352).

reads: VAR_CAMERA_MIN_X, VAR_CAMERA_MAX_X, room width (clamps, in later frames)

cost_knobs.effect: cur.x moves 8 px per frame toward dest, so the pan takes about |dest - cur|/8 frames
non-zero makes the camera jump to dest in one frame
dest is clamped each frame, so a far target ends at the clamp, sooner
frame length in jiffies, the wall-clock time of each 8 px step

in v4-6 displayDialog does nothing while dest.x/8 != cur.x/8 or the camera moved this frame, so a message queued during a pan does not start printing until the pan ends; scripts waiting on SO_WAIT_FOR_MESSAGE wait for the pan too

every actor _facing = 180

rows.notes: Opcodes 0x22/0xA2 in the v5 table (script_v5.cpp:84, 244); unused in MI1. The counter goes up each time a costume limb's animation steps onto the 0x7C counter command (costume.cpp:877-878); the step runs once per active limb (costume.cpp:842-845), so it can rise by more than 1 per frame. It resets to 0 on startAnimActor (actor.cpp:2737-2740) and on costume reset (actor.h:77-78). It only advances for actors in the current room that have a costume, while _currentRoom != 0 (actor.cpp:2323-2327, 2437-2447; scumm.cpp:3279-3292), once every max(animSpeed, 1) frames (actor.cpp:2881-2883), so a script polling it waits on AnimSpeed and VAR_TIMER_NEXT. derefActor error()s on an invalid actor.

Rewrote the colour-table write. _charsetData is copied into _charsetColorMap only by initCharset (cursorCommand SO_CHARSET_SET) and by a string's charset-switch escape (4 entries), not by text drawing in general. Added that initCharset itself calls loadCharset for a non-resident charset.
VAR_ROOM_FLAG write value changed from engine_computed to constant_or_script_value, because it always stores 1. The cite now includes the id mapping.

Notes: the main source of VAR_ROOM_FLAG = 1 is startScene's ensureResourceLoaded on a non-resident room. It is kept in notes as an effect of the room-change opcodes. Replaced 'not checked' with the fact that MI1 scripts test and clear the variable.
Added game_specific: GID_MONKEY with kEnhRestoredContent patches one room's script data whenever that room is loaded, on any load path.
Notes: the next getResourceAddress sets the usage counter back to 1, which cancels the 0x7F mark.
Notes: triggering or otherwise accessing the sound through getResourceAddress sets the counter back to 1.
Notes: the next getResourceAddress sets the counter back to 1.
Notes: the next getResourceAddress sets the counter back to 1.

Resolved the 'not traced' note. nukeCharset does not check the current charset. The renderer caches _fontPtr in setCurID, and print paths call setCurID first, but getCharWidth reads the cached pointer, so any use before the next setCurID reads freed memory.
Notes: whereIsObject finds the floating object (WIO_FLOBJECT), and so verb lookup can use it, only while its owner is OF_OWNER_ROOM. Its _objs state is set at the next updateObjectStates.
Clarified that descumm cites are in scummvm-tools, not the ScummVM engine (same for setCDVolume, setSoundLoudness, setSoundPitch).
CD-trigger write: added that re-triggering the current CD sound while pollCD() == 1 is skipped, with no restart and no CD-timer reset.

Fixed the note that said VAR_MUSIC_TIMER stays 0 whenever the sound is a CD track. It restarts from 0 only if a track actually starts. If the same CD sound is still playing, the timer is not reset and the variable jumps back to the running timer at the next updateMusicTimer.
Queue write and notes: isSoundRunning checks _currentCDSound before the queue, so a queued current CD sound can report 0. The queue is drained LIFO.
actor_costume write: read_back_by changed from [] to [o5_getAnimCounter], because startAnimActor resets _cost.animCounter.

Walk position write: added o5_actorFromPos to read_back_by for consistency with putActorAtObject, since it hit-tests the drawn actor. Added that an unreachable destination ends the walk in the last reachable box.
Facing write: the final facing can be overridden or flipped by box direction flags (flags & 7), _extraBoxFlags, or class XFlip/YFlip in remapDirection.
Not-in-room write: the _ignoreTurns guard is always false in v5, because only v6/v8 actorOps set it.

Scale write and scale cost knob: setupActorScale also runs on every redraw. For box-following actors the scale is re-read from the box, which can vary with position via a scale slot, so actorOps SO_ACTOR_SCALE persists only with ignoreBoxes.

Added reads (class XFlip/YFlip and box direction flags) and a notes entry: when the camera follows the actor, moveCamera moves the camera, sets VAR_CAMERA_POS_X and runs VAR_SCROLL_SCRIPT. This is caused by the camera mode, so it is kept out of starts/writes.

_moving write: MF_TURN can follow only for an actor already visible in the current room. For a hidden actor, showActor's adjustActorPos may set MF_TURN, but showActor then calls stopActorMoving, so _moving ends at 0.
Added actor_facing write: for an already-visible in-room actor whose new box has direction flags, the MF_TURN handler sets _facing to the box-forced direction. Read back by o5_getActorFacing.

Added actor_costume write: stand frame if the actor was moving, and on showActor the costume load plus the init frame if _costumeNeedsInit. startAnimActor resets _cost.animCounter; read back by o5_getAnimCounter.
Cost knob (box direction flags) limited to actors already visible in the current room. Scale write notes that it is recomputed on every redraw. Added the same camera-follow note as walkActorToObject.
Notes: the owner table is not checked. Picked-up objects still in the local table are skipped only because o5_pickupObject sets class 32. The class check reads _classData live.

Notes: _scalex is recomputed by setupActorScale on every redraw as well as on setBox, so actorOps SO_ACTOR_SCALE is overwritten at the next redraw unless the actor ignores boxes. The box scale can vary with position via scale slots. Added the initActor reset to 0xFF and the derefActor error cite.

Function-level ship-flag workaround: added that it only fires when the actorOps opcode byte is 0x13 (direct-byte actor operand); the var-operand forms 0x53/0x93/0xD3 never match. Updated in every actorOps row.
Removed the actor_facing write. adjustActorPos's turnToDirection(_facing) targets the current facing, and showActor's stopActorMoving cancels the MF_TURN right after, so facing never changes.
Added the missed scale write on the visible path: adjustActorPos -> setBox -> setupActorScale recomputes _scalex/_scaley/_boxscale (read by o5_getActorScale) unless the actor ignores boxes.
Added o5_wait (SO_WAIT_FOR_ACTOR reads _moving) to the moving read-back, o5_getDist to the position read-back, and the _costumeNeedsInit condition for the init anim.

Added the missed position write. On a moving actor with a changed speed, calcMovementFactor immediately runs actorWalkStep inside the opcode: it moves _pos, may change the walkbox, resets _targetFacing and may restart the walk anim and facing. Noted the no-op when the speeds are unchanged, and the stale-leg edge case when _moving is only MF_TURN.
Added o5_wait to the read_back_by list of the _moving = 0 write.
Corrected the detail. The getObjectOrActorWidth path is only reached from faceToObject for version <= 4, so it is dead in v5. walkActorToActor uses width only when its distance operand is 0xFF.
Added o5_actorFromPos to read_back_by (drawn _top/_bottom). Noted that a scale that sticks (ignoreBoxes) also scales the walk step and the walkActorToActor auto distance.
Re-cited the v5 (pre-v7) _forceClip use. actor.cpp:2577 is the v7+ branch.
Re-cited the v5 (pre-v7) _forceClip use.

Added the missed _egoPositioned write. putActor on VAR_EGO sets it, and during a loadRoomWithEgo entry script that suppresses the post-entry placement at the door object. Also added o5_wait, noted that kInvalidBox is 0 for MI1, and noted that no turn happens because the box is invalid.

Corrected the moving and facing writes. On the visible putActor path, adjustActorPos's turnToDirection leaves _moving = MF_TURN, which is never cancelled, and walkActor then turns _facing to the box-constrained direction on later frames. On the showActor path the turn is cancelled. Added o5_wait and o5_getDist.
Added the missed _egoPositioned write (same mechanism as IgnoreBoxes).
Fixed the period. The costume advances when ++_animProgress >= _animSpeed, which is every max(animSpeed, 1) frames, not animSpeed+1.

Room write: removed o5_getActorRoom from read_back_by, because it reads actor._room, which loadRoom never changes. Corrected _roomResource/VAR_ROOM_RESOURCE to use _resourceMapper for room >= 0x80 (pseudo rooms set by o5_pseudoRoom, which MI1 uses). Added _resourceMapper to reads.

stopTalk write: changed kind to var. It writes VAR_TALK_ACTOR = 0xFF via setTalkingActor, but only when a talking actor is set, and VAR_HAVE_MSG mirrors _haveMsg on the next frame. Widened read_back_by to all var readers plus o5_wait.

Shown-actor write: the init anim restarts only if _costumeNeedsInit is set. Added the box-derived scale recompute and stated that facing does not change. Added o5_getActorScale, o5_wait and o5_getDist to read_back_by.
Local object table write: added o5_getVerbEntrypoint, which returns 0 for an object no longer in the room (WIO_NOT_FOUND).

Fade-in timing: it runs later in the same engine frame (scummLoop_handleEffects, after runAllScripts), not on the next frame, and only on the non-room-0 path. Fixed the screen write and the cost knob.

Entry scripts are also skipped when _roomResource is 0. Added notes that camera._follows and _movingToActor are kept, so a camera that was catching up keeps tracking the followed actor, and that VAR_CAMERA_POS_X updates on the next frame.
Locals: all 25 locals (NUM_SCRIPT_LOCAL) take the argument list, not 0-15. Noted the kMaxScriptNesting = 15 hard error.

Added the missed indirect var write. On a frame where the camera has scrolled with message text on screen, redrawBGAreas calls stopTalk: the message ends, VAR_TALK_ACTOR = 0xFF, and VAR_HAVE_MSG = 0 on the next frame.
Added a cost knob: v4-6 displayDialog prints nothing while the camera is moving, so messages queued during a pan stall until it ends.
Added o5_loadRoomWithEgo (setCameraFollows) to the opcodes that override the pan. Noted the virtual-mouse shift and that the camera moves only when _currentRoom != 0.
Added the missed GID_MONKEY guard: ScummEngine_v5::resetScummVars sets one game script variable to a fixed value after the reset. Listed the VAR_ names resetScummVars re-initialises.
Split the lumped actor_other write into actor_room, actor_position, actor_costume, actor_facing and actor_other entries, each with its own read-back opcodes.

Added missed resetScumm writes: camera mode 0 and follows 0; _userPut = 0 and cursor state 0 (input_enable); sentence queue and message state cleared, which o5_wait SO_WAIT_FOR_SENTENCE and SO_WAIT_FOR_MESSAGE can see.
Added missed allocResTypeData clears: string resources (readable by o5_stringOps get-char), custom object names, and actor-name, inventory, verb, matrix, scale and flObject resources.
Class write: the reloaded DOBJ class bits are zeroed again for ids equal to actor numbers, because initActor(-1) runs after readIndexFile.
Clarified blocks: other scripts in the frame still run, then scummLoop returns before drawing. Fixed the VAR_QUIT_SCRIPT setup cite to ScummEngine_v90he::setupScummVars.

Notes: the counter rises when a limb steps onto command 0x7C and can rise by more than 1 per frame (once per limb). It advances only for in-room actors that have a costume while _currentRoom != 0, every max(animSpeed, 1) frames.
